title: Connect AIRA multi-model routing with safe context, tools and memory authority
whatBuilt: CONTEXT CARRIES REFERENCES, NEVER PRIVATE HISTORY: contextRefs are opaque {ref, revision} pairs, each permission-checked through the authorizer seam; unauthorized refs denied; the decision transports ONLY authorized refs
STALE REVISION + REVOKED PERMISSION REFUSED: refs below the current revision rejected; post-construction revocation fails closed (seam-driven)
TOOLS ALLOWLIST-INTERSECTED: request tools ∩ model-profile tools ∩ global allowlist; unknown tools refused outright
MEMORY CONSENT-BOUND: scopes resolve only with ACTIVE consent (ledger seam); cross-scope reads denied; revocation immediate
MODE / VOICE-TEXT HANDOFF: handoff re-routes with the SAME pinned context and records from/to; invalid modalities refused

DETERMINISTIC ROUTING: versioned table maps request classes to model profiles (pinned versions + fallback order); stale table versions refused; identical requests route identically (no timestamps in the decision); all-models-down yields a safe refusal (never an unauthorized model)
